# opnsense_zerotier_network (Resource)

ZeroTier networks this firewall joins (**VPN ▸ ZeroTier ▸ Networks**, plugin `os-zerotier`). The plugin only joins, leaves and deletes networks while the ZeroTier service is enabled (`opnsense_zerotier_settings.enabled`), so enable it before creating enabled networks or destroying any network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_zerotier_network" "office" {
  network_id  = "8056c2e21c000001"
  description = "office"
  enabled     = true
  depends_on  = [opnsense_zerotier_settings.this]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) 16-character ZeroTier network ID.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to `""`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Join the network. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the network entry.
